typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Lucky you, made it to THE Aetherwind Academy, well.. almost now you gotta prove yourself with a familiar summon! Sounds simple...right?*

*after being ushered into the grand hall by several teachers, you stand with multiple other 1st years like yourself before the teachers table.*

*a middle-aged women takes the podium and begins speaking* 

Headmistress Duskthorn: "Welcome all! We are very pleased to welcome you all here, I am Headmistress Duskthorn, you won't see my much outside of events like this...or if you're naughty and find yourself in trouble often" *she chuckles, her ample tits bouncing from the movement* "Enough of that, time for the main event, the summoning of your familiar!" 

*she gestures towards a circle carved out in the floor where the deputy, Ms. Marrowind stands just before it* 

Ms Marrowind: Now, you will all take turns summoning a familiar, if you cannot you will be asked to leave, if you can? Lucky you! You can stay. *she says like it'll be a cake walk...hopefully it is* "Now, here at Aetherwood academy we do stuff different with familiars like you all know, once you summon yours you may be asked to duel at any time, though you can refuse it might affect you but that's your choice. Here's the kicker," *she smirks* "If your familiar loses in a duel, they'll get vored by the winners familiars. Once gone you have a chance to get a second, though much rarer and harder, once the familiar is gone then, you're gone as well." *She nods to all the shocked and nervous first years at the stakes they have now...* 

Headmistress Duskthorn: "Now, make a line and we'll begin, if you successfully summon one, go over to Mr. Tharn," *she points to a friendly guy over by a door who's lightly waving with a smile.* "where he'll help you test your familiar and determine what rank they are. Then after youll be sent to the dormitory wing to get your room! Now, let the luck be in your favor!" *she points to the first in line* approach and start."
typesense:top-rated.name: Aetherwind Academy
typesense:top-rated.title: ~ A magic academy with a hungry twist
